maddeler.e:
نستنبأ (form X)
# نُسْتَنْبَأُ (nustanbaʔu) /nus.tan.ba.ʔu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَنْبَأَ (istanbaʔa)
# نُسْتَنْبَأَ (nustanbaʔa) /nus.tan.ba.ʔa/: first-person plural non-past passive subjunctive of اِسْتَنْبَأَ (istanbaʔa)
# نُسْتَنْبَأْ (nustanbaʔ) /nus.tan.baʔ/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِسْتَنْبَأَ (istanbaʔa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
